title: Institute of Contemporary Art San Diego Facing Financial Strain and Staffer Pushback
summary: Tension is boiling over at San Diego’s Institute of Contemporary Art due to a spate of recent firings, exhibition closures, and budgetary concerns, according to reports. title: Atlanta’s High Museum of Art Will Celebrate Centennial With Over 200 New Acquisitions
summary: This fall, Atlanta’s High Museum of Art will commemorate its centennial with the unveiling of significant recent acquisitions, some of which will be displayed in its American and African Art collection galleries. title: Kerstin Brätsch Wins 2027 Zurich Art Prize
summary: German painter Kerstin Brätsch has been named the winner of the twentieth Zurich Art Prize. summary: Stephan Jost, who has served as CEO and director of the Art Gallery of Ontario (AGO) in Toronto since 2016, will exit both roles at the end of the year, the museum announced.
